speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to Dr. Agent's office. I see you are a pediatric patient; to begin our evaluation for systemic hypertension, how old are you, and have you had any blood pressure readings recorded at home or at school previously?

speaker: Patient
text: 5-year-old boy. The patient is presented by his mother for a well-child visit. The boy was born at 39 weeks gestation via spontaneous vaginal delivery, is currently up to date on all vaccines, and is meeting all developmental milestones. His mother reports that he has been generally doing well with no concerns. No family history of cardiovascular disease. The boy does not take any medications.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Essential Hypertension (Secondary Etiology Unlikely Based on History). I will proceed with a focused cardiovascular examination including blood pressure measurement in both arms, femoral pulse assessment, and fundoscopy to rule out coarctation of the aorta or renal pathology.
